evidence.text: This Agreement shall be governed and construed according to the laws of the State of Kansas.

In the event a dispute arises under this Agreement which cannot be resolved, such dispute shall be submitted to arbitration and resolved by a panel of three arbitrators (who shall be lawyers), in a decision required by a majority of the arbitrators.
